title.en: BRUNEI ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT AMENDMENT ORDER 2016

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-24-2016-BRUNEI-ECONOMIC-DEVELOPMENT-BOARD-ACT-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2016.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Brunei Economic Development Board Act (Amendment) Order, 2016. of section 4 of Chapter 104

of the Brunei Economic Development Board Act is amended, in

(l){c}, by deleting "Ministry of Industry and Primary Resources" from the third line and by substituting "Energy and Industry Department in the Office of the Prime Minister" therefor. · Made this 12th. day of Rejab, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the of April, 2016 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicelak oleh Jabatan Percelakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510. Negara Brunei Darussalam. B$5.00
